product.name: Monoprice SlimRun AV HDR DisplayPort to HDTV Cable 4K@60Hz AOC 25ft
product.description: SlimRun™ AV HDR is the next generation in active optical cable systems. It features completely redesigned electronics to connect DisplayPort™ devices to HDMI® Displays with the highest performance, lowest power consumption, and lowest cost over the greatest distance. Using optical fiber to replace copper wire as the high-speed signal transmission medium, SlimRun AV HDR can perfectly transmit 4K@60Hz HDR video to distances up to 100 feet. Compared with traditional copper wire, SlimRun AV HDR is not only longer, softer, and slimmer, but also offers better signal quality without the use of external power. Compared with other optical fiber transmission solutions, SlimRun AV HDR is easy to use and has perfect compatibility, with no need for external boxes or converters. DisplayPort™ 1.2a CompliantSupports High Dynamic RangeTransmits Up To 100 FeetUltra Slim DesignDisplayPort™ 1.2a Compliant: Compliant with the DisplayPort™ 1.2a specification, this cable is also backwards compatible with DisplayPort 1.1/1.1a. With data speeds up to 21.6Gbps, this cable transmits uncompressed audio and deep color depth twice as fast as the previous specification.Supports HDR: High Dynamic Range (HDR) imaging allows you to enjoy the beauty of a wider and richer range of colors, much brighter whites, and much deeper, darker blacks.Transmits Up To 100 Feet: SlimRun™ AV HDR can perfectly transmit 4K@60Hz HDR video to distances up to 100 feet without extenders by using optical fiber to replace copper wire as the high-speed signal transmission medium.Ultra Slim Design: SlimRun™ AV HDR is thinner and softer than traditional glass fiber optic cables. Flexible polymer optical cable has a tighter bend radius and is much more resilient to damage and abuse than traditional fiber optic cables made of glass.  FeaturesHigh-speed signal transmission to distances up to 100 feetReliable data transfer immune from electromagnetic or RF interference with 0% signal lossDelivers 21.6 Gbps bandwidthHDR compliantSupports resolutions up to 4K@60HzSupports all the features contained in the latest HDMI® specificationNo external power requiredFlexible polymer optical cableUltra lightweight constructionCompliant with the VW-1 Vertical Wire Flame Test standard for safe in-wall use  Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
